title: A Map at the Mat
lines: A map! A map at the mat!
Sam and Pam and Tam sat at the map.

questions.ask: What did Tam find under the mat?
questions.listenFor: A map. It is in the fifth line. If your child is not sure, put a finger on that line and let them read it again rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Who patted the mat right before the map turned up?
questions.listenFor: Tam. Line four says it. A one word answer is a fine answer here.

questions.ask: Where do you think that map goes? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: Any place is a good answer. You are listening for a reason of their own, and it is a lovely chance to draw the place together.
